## Wookey's Brand-New Winter Wonderland!

**Step into a brand-new Winter Wonderland at Wookey Hole, bigger and more magical than ever before.** Journey through an enchanted forest, board the all-new Wookey Express, meet Father Christmas, and visit Santa's Toy Factory, where every child can choose their own special gift.

With spectacular Christmas festive entertainment, thousands of twinkling lights in the world-famous Wookey Hole Caves, and access to the entire attraction, this reimagined Christmas experience is packed with more festive fun, more magical moments, and more unforgettable family memories than ever before.

[Find out more](https://www.wookey.co.uk/winter-wonderland)

## Stay in Somerset

#### Wookey Hole Hotel

Stay right next to the famous Wookey Hole Caves in the heart of Somerset, with great-value packages that combine your accommodation and a memorable day out.

[Find out more](https://www.wookeyhotel.co.uk/ "Wookey Hole Hotel")

#### Mendip View Hot Tub Lodges

Enjoy a stylish Somerset staycation with stunning countryside views, modern comforts, and your own private hot tub to unwind in.

[Find out more](https://www.mendipviewlodges.co.uk/ "Mendip View Hot Tub Lodges")

#### Bucklegrove Holiday Park

Escape to the Somerset hills for a relaxing holiday with beautiful surroundings, family-friendly facilities, and everything you need for a stress-free stay.

[Find out more](https://www.bucklegrove.co.uk/ "Bucklegrove Holiday Park")

## Wild Wookey - For the Adventurous...

Ready to push your limits? **Wild Wookey** is a **multi-award-winning extreme caving experience** designed for **thrill-seekers, adrenaline junkies, and adventure lovers** who crave excitement!

Descend into the **hidden depths** of our **world-famous caves**, where you'll **climb, crawl, abseil, and squeeze** through exhilarating underground challenges. With expert instructors guiding you every step of the way, you'll conquer **heights, confined spaces, and rugged terrain**, emerging with **epic stories and memories to last a lifetime**.

**Dare to go Wild? Book your adventure today!**

[Find out more about Wild Wookey](https://wildwookey.co.uk/)

## Wookey Hole: An Unforgettable Family Day Out in Somerset

Wookey Hole is one of Somerset’s most iconic attractions, offering an unbeatable day out filled with caves, legends and adventure. Nestled in the heart of the Mendip Hills, this legendary destination has captivated visitors for generations with its awe-inspiring caves, fascinating stories, and exciting family-friendly activities.

Step into a world of mystery and natural beauty as you explore the world-famous caves, sculpted over millions of years. Beyond the caves, Wookey Hole is a treasure trove of fun for all ages.

Come and explore Wookey Hole - where history, adventure, and fun collide!
